method: per stash: tracked diff vs stash base + untracked commit; each (path,blob) checked against HEAD, all branch/remote history, and other stashes. Keep every stash holding content found nowhere else; for content held only by several stashes keep the newest holder. A delete candidate holds only content also kept in a retained stash or preserved in branch history.
note: Stash refs are also the only reflog entries for these commits; dropping is reversible only via `git fsck --unreachable` until gc. No stash was dropped.
